restore_requests.text: Confirmed feasible: run-B can resume from checkpoint 149 (12/60) — standard training checkpoints restore model + optimizer state and continue. No rebuild needed; we resume exactly where the checkpoint left off. Caveats: 1) verify checkpoint 149 is intact/readable before resume (it's our only recovery point — don't overwrite it until a fresh checkpoint is saved after resume); 2) after resume we need 48 continuous min — any second cut-off before ~350 loses progress again, so schedule protection in advance. Recommend we also save a new checkpoint shortly after resume (e.g., ~20 min in) so we have a fallback for the rest of the tail. I'll validate the checkpoint integrity and prep the resume command so we're ready the moment maintenance ends (~302).
